notes: City of Richmond, VA — the Virginia INDEPENDENT CITY (FIPS 51760). Not Richmond County, VA (FIPS 51159, a rural Northern Neck county), not Richmond CA, not Richmond KY.

~68.4k taxable parcels from the city's own AGOL Parcels layer (services1.arcgis.com/k3vhq11XkBNeeOfM, 2026-01-01 assessment roll). See run_richmond.py. Independent city, so the source layer is already city-only — no county clip.
Do NOT source from the same org's 'City_of_Richmond_Parcels' (CORparcels) layer: despite the name it holds only ~1,340 CITY-OWNED parcels at a 2022 assessment date. 'Parcels' is the full roll.

hideRemnants: the feed maps ~5.5k condo/LIHTC/apartment unit records with a per-unit SHARE in LandSqFt (often 0-5 sqft) against the real shared polygon; run_richmond.py falls back to geodesic polygon area whenever reported area is outside 0.5-2.0x the polygon, which drops max land $/sqft from $4.1M to $412.
